title: caragana pygmaea
intro: Caragana pygmaea, commonly known as Dwarf Siberian Pea Shrub, is a type of small shrub native to the mountainous regions of the Tibetan Plateau. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Caragana pygmaea include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Caragana pygmaea include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
